entradas.ownerIds: def owners = []; param_consultores.replaceAll("\\s","").split(";").findAll{it}.each{ p -> def kv = p.split(":",2); if (kv.length != 2) throw new RuntimeException("param_consultores mal formado"); if (kv[0].isEmpty()) throw new RuntimeException("param_consultores mal formado"); if (owners.contains(kv[0])) throw new RuntimeException("param_consultores mal formado"); owners.add(kv[0]) }; return owners.join(",")
